meanings.en: other forms: меня (gen/acc), мне (dat), мной (instr), мне (prep)
must, need to, it is necessary

examples.trans: We need to do even more.

meanings.en: other forms: тебя (gen/acc), тебе (dat), тобой (instr), тебе (prep)

examples.trans: Dad, did you bring any gum?

meanings.note: Core Russian pron meaning 'something, a thing or two' in everyday speech.

examples.trans: I want to show you something.

examples.text: И ещё кое-что. Эдуард Владимирович просил передать привет.
examples.trans: And one more thing. Eduard Vladimirovich asked us to pass on his regards.

meanings.note: once; что скажешь? = what do you say?

examples.trans: Tell us, when will your programme be out?

поступить.gloss: to enter, to get into (a university); to act

examples.trans: Yulia needs to get into university.

examples.text: Вы плохо поступили, но хотя бы совесть есть.
examples.trans: You acted badly, but at least you have a conscience.

meanings.note: in a mistaken or improper manner

examples.text: Луи, ты меня совсем неправильно понял!

meanings.note: Prefix 'пере-' denotes crossing over, repeating, or exceeding a limit (stem 'думать'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to change one's mind', paired with 'передумывать'.

examples.trans: If you change your mind, come back.
If you change your mind, come back. The job is waiting.
Nastya, did you change your mind about tonight?

examples.text: Стало быть, насчет вечера всё в силе?
examples.trans: So, is everything still on for tonight?

meanings.note: Prefix 'на-' marks surface contact, accumulation, or completing a quantity (stem 'счет').
до вечера = until the evening; вечером = in the evening

examples.text: Добрый вечер, Вика. С Новым годом!
examples.trans: Good evening, Vika. Happy New Year!

meanings.note: goes right before the word it negates
+ prepositional; об before a vowel: об этом

examples.text: Мне некогда об этом думать. Слишком много дел.
examples.trans: I have no time to think about that. There's too much to do.

meanings.note: pointing at a thing or a situation; 'это' + noun = 'this is ...'
points at something: это моё = that's mine

meanings.en: other forms: этого, этому, это, этим, этом

examples.trans: And this is for you. A toy car!

разбить.gloss: to break, to smash, to wreck (a car)

meanings.note: Prefix 'раз-' ('apart, un-, thoroughly') indicates distribution or intensive action (stem 'бить'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to break, to smash, to wreck (a car)', paired with 'разбивать'.

examples.trans: Did you wreck the car or what?

examples.text: Это от руля синяк! В какой машине? Ты машину разбил, что ли?
examples.trans: That's a bruise from a steering wheel! In what car? Did you wreck the car or what?

examples.text: Я так вспоминаю. Значит, машину разбил, что ли?
examples.trans: I'm trying to recall it. So I wrecked the car, then?

examples.text: Виктор Петрович, у вас тут зеркало сломанное.
examples.trans: Viktor Petrovich, you have a broken mirror here.
He smashes the mirror on her car.

meanings.note: emphasis: вот поэтому ты и... = that's exactly why you...

examples.trans: I was born and grew up here.

examples.text: Спасибо, спасибо! Как вы все знаете, я родился и вырос в Синеозерске.
examples.trans: Thank you, thank you! As you all know, I was born and grew up in Sineozersk.

examples.text: Теперь я начальник нашей стройки. Ты уволен!
examples.trans: Now I'm the boss of our building site. You're fired!

meanings.note: Core Russian pron meaning 'they' in everyday speech.

examples.text: Ты преподавай. А они пусть строят свои торговые центры.
examples.trans: You teach. And let them build their shopping centres.

examples.text: Из-за вашей Лёли весь класс зовёт меня врунишкой!
examples.trans: Because of your Lyolya the whole class calls me a little liar!
We were late because of the rain.

examples.text: А трава в мешках сгорела. Из-за вас!
examples.trans: And the herbs in the sacks burned. Because of you!

meanings.note: Prefix 'с-' ('together' or 'down from') marks convergence or completion (stem 'сориться'). Reflexive/intransitive verb with the postfix '-ся'/'-сь' (historically from the reflexive pronoun 'себя', oneself). Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'to quarrel, argue', paired with 'поссориться'.
usually in the genitive ничего, with не: ничего не осталось

examples.text: Ну что, очкарик? Видишь, ничего не осталось.
examples.trans: Well, four-eyes? See, there's nothing left.

examples.text: А с Пашей я снова чувствую себя женщиной.
examples.trans: And with Pasha I feel like a woman again.

examples.text: Привет! Смотри, что у меня есть.

meanings.note: Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'to do, to make', paired with 'сделать'.

examples.trans: Hi, Arkady Borisovich. What are you doing?

examples.text: Ты слишком сентиментальным стал. А лидер должен быть жёстким.
examples.trans: You've become too sentimental. And a leader has to be tough.

meanings.note: the present tense is normally left out: я мэр = I am the mayor
present есть; у меня есть = I have

examples.trans: You will be asking for forgiveness.
I grew up in a communal flat.
Hello! How was it in Hungary?
How much power does this car have?

examples.text: Да, по-моему, здорово! Сколько сил в этой машине?
examples.trans: Yes, I think it's great! How much power does this car have?

meanings.note: как вы знаете = as you know

examples.trans: Hello! How was it in Hungary?

examples.text: Этого не может быть. Это наша история.
examples.trans: That can't be. It's our history.

meanings.note: softens a request: только не сердись = just don't be angry
agrees in gender and case with the noun

examples.text: У тебя же есть ещё. Дай хоть одну.
examples.trans: But you've still got some. Give me just one.

meanings.note: думать о + prepositional = to think about

examples.trans: I have no time to think about that.

examples.text: Мне некогда об этом думать. Слишком много дел.
examples.trans: I have no time to think about that. There's too much to do.
